title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: After his actress mother dies, ordinary high schooler Yuu Ayase is taken in by the wealthy Mikadono family and shares a home with three prodigy sisters: actress Kazuki, karate champion Niko and shogi genius Miwa. Living as a family, the sisters open up to him and begin to fall for him.
life_message: It holds up kindness, hard work and accepting one's true self as worth more than raw talent.

folkways.japan: School rankings of talent, the 'Three Royals' nickname and housework as care reflect Japanese school and family culture.

delivery.note: The sources say little about delivery, so the default reading is that the message rides on the story's events.

winners_losers: Yuu's ordinary steadiness and the sisters' growth win sympathy; the idea that worth comes from talent alone loses.
